matrix_role: Original registry enumeration only. Not selection of a study population, confirmatory contrast family or new treatment.

record_to_seed_cell_bridge.requires: Exact original PairedSceneRecord, canonical same-tier original registry ArmSpecs, one shared original FutureTrainingProtocol and complete ten-event recorder trace; ordered complete two-arm maps/observations; one singleton credited receipt and state/set/protocol bindings.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.full_future_grid: Original integer training episodes0..465,466 levels per arm, locked100 ordered scenes, alpha1/2,epsilon1/10 and the shared B2 healthy reference, not the1024 F1 master reference.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.arithmetic: Original FutureUtility.from_curve and select_form with original locked Retention parameters; finite float guards and exact hex equality for utility/Retention, no tolerance, moment reconstitution or reordered sum. Signed-zero substitution is rejected.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.right_censoring: All non-recovery seeds remain defined with restricted timeT and total all-seed Retention; no tau-conditioned denominator.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.separate_dimensions: P scalar rows RMST/DeficitAUC/BehavioralCollateral/Retention; T registered statistical rows RMST/DeficitAUC; all four per-arm values retained in input payload as separate dimensions, never weighted composite.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.scalar_input_role: Already supplied measurements -> one explicit seed/cell row per registered endpoint -> independently preregistered within-seed aggregation. No cells become independent statistical seeds.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.success_route: SUCCESS/NoReflectionResult is rejected by this reflected-pair extractor, never zero-filled or silently counted as a pair. Actual cohort/factual stream preregistration must separately define the complete success/failure routing and denominators.
record_to_seed_cell_bridge.payload_digest_surface: Sorted compact UTF8 JSON over explicit float.hex full curves, original canonical ledgers, both arm values and parent/reference/cell/seed identities. Portable digest excludes process-specific object IDs. Canonical reference payload digest is not the actual reference-file SHA.

unresolved_authority_and_measurement_sur: Native record/recorder Python types can be constructed by fixtures and are not actual acquisition-origin authentication.
No factual trajectory generator or native failure origin attestation is implemented; a failure string is not proof of a factual observed failure.
Original recorder emits collateral state and set/pre-map metadata but not pre/post scalar maps, so raw BehavioralCollateral recomputation is explicitly false.
Original native eligibility-from-pair-prestate is not independently recomputed by this bridge; a nominal unaffected object does not prove its membership was correctly derived.
The bridge authenticates nominal registry bindings, not a frozen whole-study contrast family, population, disjoint seed registry, committed addon inventory or single-use collection gate.
Complete final qualified conjunction, Collateral/Retention bounds, full serial integration/mutation gates and actual dense B2 resource certification still remain open.
